prompt.en: Send each animal back to where it was watching from.
prompt.ar: أَعِدْ كُلَّ حَيَوَانٍ إِلَى المَكَانِ الَّذِي كَانَ يُرَاقِبُ مِنْه.

hint2.en: It belongs in one of these two.
hint2.ar: إِنَّهُ يَنْتَمِي إِلَى وَاحِدٍ مِنْ هَذَيْن.

model.en: This is where it goes. Now you try.

success.en: Now it can point the way.
success.ar: الآنَ يُمْكِنُهُ أَنْ يَدُلَّكَ عَلَى الطَّرِيق.

payload._comment: activeAttribute is the ONE thing being taught. heldConstant records what deliberately does not vary, because young children attend to the most salient attribute even when it is irrelevant - teaching 'sort by habitat' while sizes also differ risks teaching size instead.
